nodes.name: Manual Test Trigger
nodes.notes: Use this path for controlled historical testing. For production, add a Gmail Trigger and connect it to Clean Email Data after testing.

filters.q: newer_than:30d (job OR internship OR hackathon OR fellowship OR scholarship OR hiring)

nodes.name: Gmail Search
nodes.notes: Connect your own Gmail OAuth2 credential. Edit q with a Gmail-valid query; test it in Gmail first.

nodes.name: Clean Email Data
nodes.notes: Normalizes common Gmail fields, removes excess payload data, strips simple HTML, and limits AI input to 12,000 characters.

nodes.name: OpenAI Analysis
nodes.notes: Connect your own OpenAI credential and use a JSON-capable model. The exact model may be changed after import.

nodes.name: Validate Structured Output
nodes.notes: Rejects malformed responses, bounds numeric values, and safely prepares comma-separated arrays for Sheets.

nodes.name: Is Opportunity?
nodes.notes: False branch intentionally ends; inspect its execution output for debugging without adding email content to a separate store.

nodes.name: Google Sheets Append Row
nodes.notes: Connect your own Google Sheets credential and choose the spreadsheet/worksheet. Create headers first, then map them to this node's input fields. Add a message-ID lookup before this node for production duplicate prevention.
